avg_wage_2025.note: Przeciętne wynagrodzenie w gospodarce narodowej w 2025 r., announced by the President of GUS (Statistics Poland) on 9 Feb 2026. Used as of 2026 to set the EU Blue Card salary threshold (150%) and the business-activity residence permit income threshold (12x, on a regional Q3 basis, approximated here at national level pending regional GUS breakdowns).

min_wage_2026.note: National statutory minimum gross wage from 1 January 2026 (PLN 31.40/hour). Floor for standard work-permit and Single Permit salary conditions.

eu_blue_card_threshold_2026.note: 150% of avg_wage_2025 (8903.56 x 1.5 = 13,355.34). Re-baselines every February when GUS announces the prior year's average wage.

business_income_threshold_2026.note: 12x avg_wage_2025 (8903.56 x 12), a national-level approximation. The statutory figure is actually 12x the average monthly wage in the specific voivodeship where the business is seated, for Q3 of the year preceding the application, as announced by the President of GUS -- not the national annual average used here. This is a flagged simplification: true threshold varies by voivodeship and uses a Q3-specific regional figure, not this national annual figure. Treat resolved_amount on the business route as indicative, not exact, until regional Q3 figures are added.
